observed_title: A Stability Result for a Family of Sharp Gagliardo-Nirenberg Inequalities
version: PDF side arXiv:1610.06869v1 21Oct2016; manuscript front date September28,2018. These conflicting observed dates retained; no claim that newer-version metadata was checked.

read_ranges.scope: All introduction/background, sections2–5 proofs, detailed Appendix section6 calculations(4.3)–(4.9), references. All nonempty source text read with original line locators; truncated line298 separately reread.

topic_relevance.basis: Small GN deficit controls L1 distance between density powers modulo scaling/translation; continuous-dimensional lift, parameter normalization, BE stability, and Minkowski integral inequality.

definitions.name: Optimizer manifold
definitions.statement: v_(λ,x0)=λ^(n/(2t))(1+λ²|x−x0|²)^(-1/(t−1)), λ>0,x0∈R^n; normalization ||u||_(2t)=||v||_(2t) fixes amplitude. Distance is L1 between u^(2t) and v_(λ,x0)^(2t), not H1 distance to u itself.

theorem_cards.label: Theorem1.10 / Eq1.25
assumptions: Nonnegative u∈Ḣ1(R^n), relevant L^(2t) and L^(t+1) norms finite
Algebraic finite-lift interior only: n≥2,1<t<n/(n−2) for n>2; finite t>1 for n2. This is not the revised external BE stability domain.
δ_GN≤δ1(n,t); K1,δ1 depend on fixed n,t
If binding to actually read BEv2, compatibility narrows to1<t≤(2n+1)/(2n−3),n≥2, and its unresolved proof gaps still prevent a gap-free stability certificate.
theorem_cards.statement: Author states ∃K1(n,t),δ1(n,t)>0 such that inf_(λ>0,x0) ||u^(2t)−v_(λ,x0)^(2t)||_1≤K1 sqrt(δ_GN[u]) for small deficit.
proof_steps: Normalize gradient-to-L^(t+1) ratio by a positive dilation preserving L^(2t) norm and deficit
Lift into weighted Sobolev space in radial dimension m and n ordinary coordinates; exact lifted Sobolev deficit equals C1δ_GN
Apply continuous-dimension Bianchi–Egnell theorem cited from [Se]; use Sobolev to turn H1 distance into L^p* distance
Control amplitude and lifted scale via Lemma3.1, Chebyshev/Fubini two radial samples, and Minkowski integral inequality
Lemma4.1 splits relative profiles into comparable/far regions and translates lifted distance to L1 density-power distance; Appendix supplies the detailed radial calculations
Undo normalization dilation, retaining translations and scales
gaps: The finite-lift proof requires m>0. Prop2.1 prints t≤n/(n−2), but critical t makes m=0 and ω_mρ^(m−1) is outside cited theorem. This proof does not establish its critical endpoint; t=1 corresponds infinite m and undefined v profile.

Lemma3.1 p16 derivative lower bound γλ^(γ−1)≥γ2^(1−γ) assumes γ≥1. For 0<γ<1 the positive lower bound on λ∈[1/2,4] is γ4^(γ−1), so printed explicit constants need adjustment. Main existence claim is not thereby disproved.
No parameter-uniform stability constants, large-deficit extension, or PDE theorem is independently certified.

At t=1, μ=0 and base GN inequality degenerates; v exponent1/(t−1) is undefined, so its optimizer-distance conclusion is not used. At critical t one could seek a separate classical BE argument, but that endpoint transfer is not certified here.

Referenced BEv1 m>0 was superseded in2020 by v2m≥1. The actually read v2 has no support for0<m<1, and its full-space3-mode kernel proof omits translations. Historical GNstatement, algebraic lift identity, revised dependency compatibility and unresolved global proof are distinct.

theorem_cards.label: Proposition2.1 exact lift / Eq2.4
assumptions: Nonnegative u with finite relevant norms
proof_steps: Compute the radial integrals by ρ=sqrt(w_u)θ
Match the two energy coefficients using the fixed gradient/norm ratio and equality at v
gaps: Zero values of u require extended profile and approximation/chain-rule justification; no general singular input regularization certified here.
Printed endpoint includes m=0; restrict this identity construction to m>0 rather than replacing endpoint by an unstated limiting argument.

theorem_cards.label: Lemma3.1 parameter removal
assumptions: L^p* distance to zF_(s,x0) small relative to m,n-dependent threshold
theorem_cards.statement: After fixing lifted amplitude and scale, ||φ−F_(1,x0)||_(p*)≤C4(m,n)sqrtδ. Formula for C4 in source is parameter dependent despite text saying universal.
proof_steps: For nonnegative φ,F, replace complex z by |z| pointwise without increasing distance; use reverse norm triangle and norm equality to remove amplitude
A radial two-sample Fubini argument bounds |1−1/s|, then |s−1| and confines s to [1/2,3/2]
||F_s−F_1||_(p*)≤∫||∂_sF_s||_(p*)ds≤2γ|s−1|||F||_(p*), by Minkowski integral inequality in weighted product measure
gaps: Source z≥0 phrase is not meaningful for general complex z; explicit modulus reduction is a local repair.
The displayed intermediate derivative lower bound needs piecewise γ-dependent minimum; corrected constants and smallness threshold not fully propagated to numerical K1.
Set A is printed centered at x0 although scaled expression uses sx0; use consistent sx0 centering for the local Fubini comparison.

theorem_cards.label: Lemma4.1 and Appendix density transfer
proof_steps: Split w_u<H and w_u>H; then comparable H/2≤w_u<H versus far w_u<H/2
Comparable region uses mean value, Hölder, radial scaling and optimizer mass
Far region splits 2<m+n≤4 versus m+n≥4 because m+n−p* changes sign
Appendix computes all formulas4.3–4.9, followed by symmetric region and small norm to conclude
gaps: p22 writes tildeθ=sqrt(w_u/H)θ, opposite substitution needed to get next line. Correct θ=sqrt(w_u/H)tildeθ, equivalently tildeθ=sqrt(H/w_u)θ; first Appendix case writes the correct direction.
Explicit C5 OCR is not reused without algebraic reconstruction; existence and fixed-parameter dependence retained.

constant_dependence.scope: K1(n,t),δ1(n,t)>0 fixed-parameter existential; lifted α(m,n),C0,C1,C4,C5 also depend on dimensions. Explicit printed C4 needs γ<1 repair.
constant_dependence.power: Small-deficit sqrtδ estimate for L1 density powers. Source [Se] quadratic BE exponent optimal; no independent claim K1 or δ1 numerically sharp.
constant_dependence.minkowski: Integral norm inequality used for F_s curve in L^p*(ω_mρ^(m−1)dρ dx), p*>1,m>0, s confined to [1/2,3/2]; no unrestricted mixed-norm interchange.

endpoint_limits.not_established: Critical t=n/(n−2), t→1,m→∞, n/t-uniform constants, unnormalized amplitude, arbitrary signs/complex u, maximal-cube extreme-point stability.
endpoint_limits.scope: Fix n,t and normalize L^(2t) norm; retain full optimizer manifold and input space.
endpoint_limits.source_endpoints: Background Eq1.5 includes t=1 and critical t, while Th1.10 uses v profile and finite lift. Both endpoints are separately quarantined from this finite-lift proof.
endpoint_limits.revised_dependency_range: BEv2 only m≥1, so compatible GNlift1<t≤(2n+1)/(2n−3); n2t≤5. Historical m>0 broad claim not adopted; compatibility is not certification.

reusable_methods.method: Normalize redundant scale before BE lift
reusable_methods.transfer: Prove actual functional and mass scale invariance, and ability to attain the normalization ratio.

reusable_methods.method: Lift into an auxiliary weighted dimension then compare density powers
reusable_methods.transfer: Verify m>0, radial weight, finite integrals, chain rules and all exponents; endpoint substitution is not automatic.

reusable_methods.method: Minkowski integral inequality for a parameter path
reusable_methods.transfer: Requires integrable norm derivative and compact parameter range; does not validate arbitrary norm order or limit exchanges.

checked_derivation.statement: n=3,t=3 gives m=4*3/(3−1)−6=0; n=2,t=5 gives m=1,γ=1/2. Therefore Prop2.1 printed critical inclusion cannot call m>0 BE lift.

γ=1/2,λ=2 gives γλ^(γ−1)=1/(2sqrt2) whereas γ2^(1−γ)=1/sqrt2. More directly ξ=2,η=1 gives |sqrtξ−sqrtη|=sqrt2−1<1/sqrt2|ξ−η|, both within [1/2,4]. The numeric derivative bound is false for γ<1, not a counterexample to Theorem1.10.
For λ∈[1/2,4], γλ^(γ−1)≥γ min(2^(1−γ),4^(γ−1))>0. This repairs local invertibility estimate with γ-dependent constants; numerical threshold propagation not checked.
a,b≥0,z∈C imply |a−|z|b|≤|a−zb|. Thus remove complex phase before source positive-z reasoning.
